Lemma
[Area decay when boundary length is controlled] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0266 ↗ lem:chow-iv-minimizing-disk-evolution 1. ch33:33.30\group Minimal disks

If, at a sufficiently large time, $L_{g(t)}(\partial D(t))\le (1+\varepsilon )^{-1}A_{\mathfrak T_A}(t)$, then \[ \frac{d^+A_{\mathfrak T_A}}{dt}(t)\le -2\pi . \]
